caveats: No validated percentage of all bundling work that can or cannot be automated is available.
Mechanical-change category share is a review bucket, not an eligibility estimate or upper bound.
Categories contain false positives, including Jira fix-version comments labeled as dependency updates.
No percentages here are effort-weighted, time savings, or validated automation accuracy.
Investigation and decision labels do not prove permanent inability to automate.

current_capability_limits.actor_parameter: One registered actor key and exact approved source value; not a general parameter editor
current_capability_limits.copy_pinned_file: One registered real target/commit/blob tuple; demonstrated with a prepared source replay
current_capability_limits.dependency_pin: Fixture dependency schema only; implemented, no real dependency replay demonstrated
current_capability_limits.shared_sync: Demonstrated through explicit fixture copies and equality checks
current_capability_limits.verification: Registered hashes, exact fields, content and variant/path checks; no scientific/physical validation

denominator_description: Automatically proposed, unreviewed action excerpts; not validated tasks or effort hours
